name: UIUC DA4022 9-in propeller (2 blades, c/R = 0.23 rectangular, SDA1075)

sda1075.polar_source: XFOIL 6.97, Ncrit=9, Re 20k/30k/40k/60k/80k/100k/150k/200k (computed; no measured polar exists for this section)

experiments.conditions: UIUC 2.8x4.0 ft low-turbulence tunnel (Tu < 0.1 %), B=2, constant rpm per run (2018, 3039, 4042, 4055, 5030, 5068 rpm), tunnel speed varied; blade-angle offset +0 deg; tunnel corrections applied by UIUC.
experiments.uncertainty: not given by the source; ~+-3-5 % in CT/CP estimated from the published repeatability

experiments.conditions: static (J = 0, tunnel off), B=2, rpm swept 1326-5940; blade-angle offset +0 deg
experiments.source: UIUC Propeller Database Vol. 2, file da4022_9x6.75_static_0767rd.txt (tabulated)

sources.citation: Brandt, J.B., Deters, R.W., Ananda, G.K., Dantsker, O.D., and Selig, M.S., UIUC Propeller Database, Vols 1-4, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Department of Aerospace Engineering (downloaded 2026-10-18, archive UIUC-propDB.zip md5 a41e484f1fd0fb6ff80b76e27410808b)

Deters, R.W., 'Performance and Slipstream Characteristics of Small-Scale Propellers at Low Reynolds Numbers', PhD dissertation, University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, 2014

notes: 3D-printed UIUC research propeller (Deters 2014). Blades are inserted in interchangeable hubs: three extra hubs change the blade angle by -10, -5 and +5 deg (Deters et al. 2014 Sec. III, Table 2), which is how the 'pitched' data sets were produced; their offset is the experiment's pitch_deg (nominal hub value). Geometry = UIUC 'tested' PropellerScanner geometry (both blades averaged) with the tip artefact corrected (see geometry.csv header); PropellerScanner may underestimate twist (Uhlig, cited by Deters et al. 2014), and the scanned twist is 1-2 deg above design over the outer blade, so geometry_design.csv (in extraction/) is a useful sensitivity check. Root: r/R 0.15-0.25 is the blade neck between hub block and blade (chord drops to c/R ~0.11-0.14); the solver blade starts at the first station (Rhub = 0.15 R). Blade material: 3D-printed plastic, flexible at higher rpm (Deters et al. 2014 say the 12 % airfoils were chosen to stiffen the blades). Polars: XFOIL Ncrit = 9 (tunnel Tu < 0.1 %); Ncrit = 5 alternative files are listed in each airfoil entry. Chord Re at 0.75R ranges ~31k-79k (c75 = 26.6 mm, 0.75*Omega*R at the lowest/highest tested rpm). Fluid: UIUC lab air assumed rho = 1.17 kg/m3, nu = 1.55e-5 m2/s (Urbana, ~225 m altitude, ~22 C; the database gives coefficients only).
